title: Candidate-bound bottom sensible-energy publication current-canonical admission

Preserve exact candidate lineage, accepted commit receipt binding, reject/retry rollback semantics, hard water-mass conservation, prescribed-qbot behavior and current drainage/runtime semantics.

hard_nonclaims: F-CI63 admits only the qualified bottom sensible-energy publication scope; it does not claim the complete SWAP energy balance is finished.
The qualification-only 2.5e-11 cm temporal head budget is not a production, coupling or application default.
The exact zero comparison used for bottom donor classification remains an intentional exact contract, not a numerical tolerance policy.
No canonical admission exists until the exact F-CI63 qualification head is green, promoted by a true two-parent merge, and postimage-reconciled.
